svg.title: Sanzeed stamp — rectangular 58 × 22 mm (editable text)
svg.desc: Border 0.6 mm, horizontal-descriptor lockup 50 mm (minimum size) with the plain wordmark (no points: the Z ring gap would be 0.19 mm, below the 0.5 mm stamp minimum), contact in Inter Tight Bold 6.2 pt. 1 unit = 1 mm. Single colour black (100 K). No bleed — the stamp maker uses the outer cut circle/rectangle.
